scripts.build:sdks: npm run generate:sdks && npm run build:sdk:typescript && npm run build:sdk:python && npm run build:sdk:swift && npm run build:sdk:go
scripts.test: node --test tests/worker.test.mjs tests/configure.test.mjs tests/connections.test.mjs tests/writes.test.mjs && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:sdks: npm run test:sdk:typescript && npm run test:sdk:rust && npm run test:sdk:python && npm run test:sdk:swift && npm run test:sdk:go
scripts.test:sdk:typescript: npm run build:sdk:typescript && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p sdks/typescript/tests/tsconfig.json && node --test sdks/typescript/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.check:sdks: python3 scripts/test_sdk_contracts.py && python3 scripts/generate_sdks.py --check && node scripts/export_sdk_fixtures.mjs --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path sdks/rust/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path sdks/rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm run check:sdk:python && npm run check:sdk:go && npm run test:sdks
scripts.check: python3 scripts/export_api.py --check && python3 scripts/test_sdk_contracts.py && python3 scripts/generate_sdks.py --check && node scripts/export_sdk_fixtures.mjs --check && python3 scripts/check_site.py && python3 scripts/check_reference.py && node --check dist/app.js && npm test && npm run test:sdk:typescript
scripts.test:sdk:python: node scripts/export_sdk_fixtures.mjs --check && python3 -m pip install --no-deps -e ./sdks/python && python3 -m unittest discover -s sdks/python/tests -v
scripts.test:sdk:go: node scripts/export_sdk_fixtures.mjs --check && cd sdks/go && go test -race ./...
scripts.check:sdk:python: cargo fmt --manifest-path sdks/python/native/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path sdks/python/native/Cargo.toml --lib -- -D warnings
